questions.q: The traditional commercial law principle of *Caveat Emptor* directly translates to...
questions.explain: *Caveat Emptor* is a Latin phrase meaning **"let the buyer beware."** It historically meant that buyers were entirely responsible for checking the quality and suitability of goods before making a purchase. Modern consumer protection laws were created specifically to soften the harshness of this principle.
